newsitem.title: UK: Dixons firm as analysts upgrade forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Dixons firm as analysts upgrade forecasts.

text.p: Shares in British electricals retailer Dixons Group Plc held firm as retail sector analysts upgraded profit forecasts.

SBC Warburg added 20 million stg to its forecast for 1997/98, taking its pre-tax profit prediction to 240 million. It increased its pre-tax profit forecast for 1998/99 by 25 million stg to 285 million, analysts said.
Dixons reported a 41 percent increase in annual profits to 190.2 million stg, at the top end of market expectations and a 17 percent sales surge over the past nine weeks.
The group's shares were 34 pence higher at 526.5 pence by 1205 GMT. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
